name: f3-tool-events
description: INV3 tool interlude: hermes.tool.progress events (websearch, then labeled read_file) sit between token deltas; each tool runs > ACTIVITY_HOLD_MS (800ms) so its live-activity sentence survives the anti-flicker hold; a truncated JSON frame is injected just before [DONE] (malformedAtEnd). Stream must finish, activity line must show, bubble count must stay at one, text must be exact.

turns.userPrompt: Search and then finish the thought

events.delta: read a note, then finished the thought in place.
